third_party\dll-win64\sqlite3.dll -- the SQLite engine drag-lint ships and loads

Version : 3.45.3 (x64, PE machine 0x8664)
SHA256  : c323cb98d4eb7f3b885ccc0a6f5b8420291ff065afbd95f6f89954bfd3c5af0c
Size    : 3172896 bytes
Origin  : C:\Program Files (x86)\Embarcadero\Studio\37.0\bin64\sqlite3.dll
          (RAD Studio 13), copied 2026-10-07.
License : SQLite is in the public domain.

Why this exact file: until 2026-10-07 drag-lint set no VendorLib, so the
loader took whatever sqlite3.dll PATH reached first, which on the reference
machine was this very file. Every index built so far was written by it, so
bundling the same bytes changes nothing (index_db_diff.py IDENTICAL) while
removing the dependency on a Delphi 13 install. A machine with only Delphi
10.3 has no x64 sqlite3.dll on PATH at all (Studio\20.0\bin is 32-bit).

How it is loaded: DRagLint.Storage.SQLite pins TFDPhysSQLiteDriverLink.VendorLib
to <exe dir>\sqlite3.dll at unit initialization. A missing file fails the first
connection ("Cannot load vendor library [path]"); PATH is never consulted.
`drag-lint --version` prints the version and the path that loaded.

Win32: there is NO third_party\dll-win32\sqlite3.dll. The Win32 build is retired,
and RAD Studio 13's x86 Studio\37.0\bin\sqlite3.dll is SQLite 3.8.10 (2015, no
FTS5 trigram tokenizer), so it cannot serve. pack-lint-release.ps1 therefore
fails the win32 archive loudly, as it already did for the missing Win32 exe.

Upgrading: replace the file, update this record, and MEASURE first -- the
version decides the query planner (see the sqlite_stat1 note in
DRagLint.Storage.SQLite.pas). Needs FTS5 with the trigram tokenizer (3.34+).
